title: THE DEVIL BEHIND THE MASK: AN EMERGENT SAFETY VULNERABILITY OF DIFFUSION LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and testing technical safety vulnerabilities and jailbreak attacks (DIJA) specific to Diffusion LLMs. While it utilizes benchmarks like HarmBench and StrongREJECT to evaluate the model's refusal of harmful or unethical instructions, its core contribution is a security analysis of model architecture rather than a dedicated evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
